ctx.x: Jean Bach’s passion for jazz has reaped an unexpected benefit for all jazz lovers. As a young woman she followed the Ellington band and became an expert on his music. Her first husband added his love of Basie and together they became amateur jazz historians. Jean gained media experience as producer of “The Arlene Francis Radio Show” and later with her involvement in “The Sound of Jazz” Television series. Jean was interviewed by Monk Rowe in New York City on October 18, 1995.

Good afternoon. We’re filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, and we have a very interesting guest with us, Ms. Jean Bach. Welcome. This is special because we’ve had some musicians, we’ve had musicians’ wives and we’ve had an agent or two, but you’re the first film producer and “jazz source” I’m going to call you.
